answer: Random juries with slashing: each answer is judged by a small jury drawn by an unpredictable on-chain seed, and every juror must stake tokens. Jurors who vote against the final consensus lose part of that stake in the forge of settlement. A sybil swarm cannot choose which seats it lands in, so packing a jury means owning a huge share of all staked identities, a cost as hard as basalt, while a lone fake grazing the meadow of easy votes is caught and slashed.
